label: Memory Archivist
description: Maintains 10+ years of library history and scanned family prints. Highest emotional distress when search fails.

label: Utility Capturer
description: Relies on photos as an external hard drive for receipts, serial numbers, router barcodes, and screenshots.
dominant_workaround: Pulling furniture away to re-photograph or checking email

label: Candid Chronicler
description: Parents and visual storytellers looking for specific unposed moments, clothing colors, and candid interactions.
dominant_workaround: Texting spouse/family member asking for their copy

label: Casual Searcher
description: Infrequent searchers who expect quick conversational retrieval and abandon queries after 1-2 attempts.
